title: Preserve pending edits through a history preview
steps: Select the Rectangle tool and draw a rectangle while background saves are delayed.
Before autosave finishes, open History and request a preview of Before current edit; observe past the autosave interval and save-delay release.
Exit the version preview and inspect the live workspace.
Return to Projects and reopen Version Preview Study.

video_guide.summary: Preview the earlier empty version, then exit and reopen the file from Dashboard. The current rectangle briefly returns after Exit but is missing after reopening.

chapters.note: A new rectangle is selected on the canvas before the history preview.
Previewing version: Before current edit shows the earlier empty canvas, with Exit and Restore available.
The historical preview remains empty; this is the version being inspected.
After Exit, the current rectangle briefly reappears on the canvas.

chapters.label: Reopen the live file through Dashboard

chapters.note: After returning to Dashboard and reopening the file, the rectangle is missing from both the canvas and Layers.
